column1: # Measured impact of removing rdo_tx_type_decision's first-iteration early-exit
# (zenrav1e@6b3b0493, pushed to master, unreleased). See docs/RD_GAP_VS_LIBAOM.md "Fixed
# 2026-07-01" for the full writeup. The tx-type RDO search bailed out of trying any non-DCT_DCT
# type whenever DCT_DCT alone (always tried first) already cost more than the best RD found
# across other tx sizes so far -- content where a non-DCT type wins by a wide margin at that
# specific size never got a chance. Found via the inspect-diff per-syntax-element bit-cost
# breakdown: av1_read_tx_type showed libaom spending more bits (2.5%->3.6%) than zenrav1e on
# tx-type signaling, suggesting the search wasn't finding non-DCT winners as often as it could.
# Harness: scripts/rd_gap/run_gap.sh, cavif -s2, 22-image photo corpus, 12-point Q grid, same
# methodology as the topdown-fix measurement. "fixed" = topdown+deblock fixes only (665e58e4 +
# dc0a1165); "txtype" = fixed + this change (now master's actual state, 6b3b0493).
# Direct txtype-vs-fixed (isolates this change; no libaom involved), bpp change at matched
# ssim2, - = txtype needs FEWER bits (better):
target_ssim2
# Against the same-day libaom baseline (single format/config both sides):
condition
fixed_vs_libaom (before this fix)

# the topdown fix), fading to exactly 0 at 85+ (the tx-size RDO search converges to the same
